name: Brokers Online
description: Distinct count of broker instances reporting kafka_server_replicamanager_value{name=LeaderCount}.
programText: data('kafka_server_replicamanager_value', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker') and filter('name', 'LeaderCount')).count().publish(label='Brokers Online')
